mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO video_view (id, user_id, video_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{videoId})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS video_id, v.author_id, u.username AS author_name, v.title, v.description, v.play_url, v.cover_url, v.like_count, v.created_at, vv.viewed_at FROM video_view vv INNER JOIN video v ON v.id = vv.video_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.author_id WHERE vv.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vv.viewed_at DESC, v.created_at DESC
